sub_parameters.name: ArnUser

sub_parameters.name: Domain
sub_parameters.description: The domains of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance. By default, all domains of the instance are used. You can specify individual domains, separated by commas.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceName

sub_parameters.name: RegionId

parameters.name: AutoCreateEip

parameters.name: AutoMatchImageCache
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically match image caches. Default value: false.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ComputeCategory
parameters.description: The compute categories. For more information, see [Create instances by specifying compute categories](~~2638061~~).

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: The container information.

sub_parameters.name: Arg
sub_parameters.description: The arguments for the container startup command. Maximum: 10.

sub_parameters.name: Command
sub_parameters.description: The container startup commands. Maximum: 20. Each command can contain up to 256 characters.

sub_parameters.name: Cpu
sub_parameters.description: The vCPU size of the container. Unit: cores.

sub_parameters.name: EnvironmentVar
sub_parameters.description: The environment variables of the container.

sub_parameters.name: EnvironmentVarHide
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to hide environment variable information when querying ECI instance details. Valid values:

- false (default): environment variable information is returned when querying ECI instance details.
- true: environment variable information is not returned when querying ECI instance details. Setting this to true improves security when environment variables contain sensitive information.

sub_parameters.name: Gpu
sub_parameters.description: The number of GPUs assigned to the container.

sub_parameters.name: Image
sub_parameters.description: The container image.

sub_parameters.name: ImagePullPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: always pull. Pulls the image every time.
- IfNotPresent: pull on demand. Uses the local image first. Pulls the image if no local image is available.
- Never: never pull. Uses the local image only.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.Exec.Command
sub_parameters.description:
The commands executed in the container for command-based health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.FailureThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of consecutive failures required to consider the check failed after a success. Default value: 3.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Path
sub_parameters.description:
The path for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Port
sub_parameters.description:
The port number for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.HttpGet.Scheme
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type for HTTP request health checks. Valid values:
- HTTP
- HTTPS

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.InitialDelaySeconds
sub_parameters.description: The time to start the check, calculated from when the container finishes starting.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.PeriodSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The interval at which the check is performed. Default value: 10 seconds. Minimum value: 1 second.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.SuccessThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of consecutive successes required to consider the check successful after a failure. Default value: 1. Must be 1.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.TcpSocket.Port
sub_parameters.description:
The port for TCP Socket health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: LivenessProbe.TimeoutSeconds
sub_parameters.description: The timeout period for the check. Default value: 1 second. Minimum value: 1 second.

sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: Name

sub_parameters.name: Port

sub_parameters.description:
The commands executed in the container for command-based health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.FailureThreshold
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of consecutive failures required to consider the check failed after a success. Default value: 3.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Path
sub_parameters.description:
The path for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Port

The port number for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.HttpGet.Scheme
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type for HTTP request health checks. Valid values:
- HTTP
- HTTPS

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.InitialDelaySeconds

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.SuccessThreshold

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.TcpSocket.Port

sub_parameters.name: ReadinessProbe.TimeoutSeconds

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.Capability.Add
sub_parameters.description:
The permissions granted to processes in the container. Currently, only NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW are supported.

> NET_RAW is not supported by default and requires a ticket submission.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.ReadOnlyRootFilesystem
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. Currently, only true is supported.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.RunAsUser
sub_parameters.description: The user ID used to run the container.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContextPrivileged
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable privilege mode for the container. Valid values:
- true: enable privilege mode.
- false (default): disable privilege mode.

> The privileged container feature is in beta. To use it, submit a ticket.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContextRunAsGroup
sub_parameters.description: The user group ID used to run the container.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContextRunAsNonRoot
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to run the container in non-root mode. Valid values:
- true: non-root mode.
- false (default): root mode.

sub_parameters.name: Stdin
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether this container should allocate a buffer for standard input in the container runtime. If not set, reads from standard input in the container will result in EOF. Default value: false.

sub_parameters.name: StdinOnce
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions when standard input is set to true.
If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts, remains empty until the first client attaches to standard input, then stays open and accepts data until the client disconnects. Standard input is then closed and remains closed until the container restarts.

sub_parameters.name: TerminationMessagePath
sub_parameters.description: The path for the container error message.

sub_parameters.name: TerminationMessagePolicy
sub_parameters.description: The message notification policy. Default value: empty. Currently, only lightweight message queue notification is supported.

sub_parameters.name: Tty
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable interaction. Default value: false.

When Command is /bin/bash, this must be set to true.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMount
sub_parameters.description: The volume mount information.

sub_parameters.name: WorkingDir
sub_parameters.description: The working directory of the container.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the ECI instance (container group). Format requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
- The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen.

parameters.name: ContainerResourceView
parameters.description: When the ECI specification is larger than the requested specification, you can enable this setting to ensure that the resources visible inside the container are consistent with the requested resources.

parameters.name: CorePattern
parameters.description:
Custom directory for saving core dump files generated by coredump. For more information, see [Save core files to a data volume](~~167801~~).

> The configured path cannot start with `|`, which means you cannot configure executable programs through core dump.

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.description: The instance-level vCPU size. Unit: cores.

parameters.name: CpuArchitecture
parameters.description:
The CPU architecture of the ECI instance. Valid values:

- AMD64 (default)
- ARM64

parameters.name: CpuOptionsCore
parameters.description: The number of physical CPU cores. Only some instance types support custom settings.

parameters.name: CpuOptionsNuma
parameters.description: This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: CpuOptionsThreadsPerCore
parameters.description: The number of threads per core. Only some instance types support custom settings. Setting this to 1 disables hyper-threading.

parameters.name: DataCacheBucket
parameters.description: The data cache bucket.

parameters.name: DataCacheBurstingEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable burst performance when the data cache uses ESSD AutoPL cloud disks. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks](~~368372~~).

parameters.name: DataCachePL
parameters.description:
The performance level of the cloud disk used by the data cache.
ESSDs are used preferentially, and the default performance level is PL1.

parameters.name: DataCacheProvisionedIops
parameters.description:
The provisioned read/write IOPS when the data cache uses ESSD AutoPL cloud disks.
Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 * capacity - baseline performance}. Baseline performance = min{1800 + 50 * capacity, 50000}.
For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks](~~368372~~).

parameters.name: DnsConfig.NameServer
parameters.description: The list of IP addresses of DNS servers.

parameters.name: DnsConfig.Option
parameters.description: The list of options.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the option.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the option.

parameters.name: DnsConfig.Search
parameters.description: The list of DNS search domains.

parameters.name: DnsPolicy
parameters.description:
The DNS policy. Valid values:

- None: uses the DNS configured by the DnsConfig field.
- Default: inherits the DNS settings of the runtime environment.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs a dry run without creating an ECI instance. The system checks required parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRun.Success is returned.
- false (default): sends a normal request. After the check passes, the ECI instance is created.

parameters.name: EgressBandwidth
parameters.description: The outbound bandwidth limit. Unit: Bps.

parameters.name: EipBandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth of the EIP. Default value: 5 Mbps.
This parameter can be set when AutoCreateEip is set to true.

parameters.name: EipCommonBandwidthPackage
parameters.description: The ID of an existing shared bandwidth package to associate.

parameters.name: EipISP
parameters.description:
The line type of the EIP. Valid values:

- BGP (default): BGP (multi-ISP) line.
- BGP_PRO: BGP (multi-ISP) premium line.

parameters.name: EipInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP).

parameters.name: EphemeralStorage
parameters.description:
The size of the additional temporary storage space. Unit: GiB.
For more information, see [Customize the size of temporary storage](~~204066~~).

parameters.name: FixedIp
parameters.description: Set to true to enable fixed IP addresses for the instance. For details, see [Configure ECI instances to use fixed IP addresses](~~2381086~~).

parameters.name: FixedIpRetainHour
parameters.description: The retention period of the fixed IP address after it becomes idle, i.e., the retention period after the instance with the fixed IP address is released. Unit: hours. Default value: 48.

parameters.name: GpuDriverVersion
parameters.description:
The GPU driver version.

> Only some instance types support switching GPU driver versions. For more information, see [Create instances by specifying GPU specifications](~~2579486~~).

parameters.name: HostAliase
parameters.description: The host aliases for the ECI instance.

sub_parameters.name: Hostname
sub_parameters.description: The host names to add.

sub_parameters.name: Ip
sub_parameters.description: The IP address to add.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The host name.

parameters.name: HostSecurityContext.Sysctl
parameters.description: Modifies unsafe sysctl parameters through the security context. For more information, see [Configure Security Context](~~462313~~).

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the unsafe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context. Valid values:

- kernel.shm* (except kernel.shm_rmid_forced)
- kernel.msg*
- kernel.sem
- fs.mqueue.*
- net.* (except net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies, net.ipv4.ping_group_range, and net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start)

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the unsafe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context.

parameters.name: ImageAccelerateMode
parameters.description:
The image acceleration mode. Valid values:

- nydus: uses Nydus acceleration. The image must support it.
- dadi: uses DADI acceleration. The image must support it.
- p2p: uses P2P acceleration. The image must support it.
- imc: uses image cache acceleration.

parameters.name: ImageSnapshotId
parameters.description: The image cache ID. For more information, see [Use image caches to accelerate instance creation](~~141281~~).

parameters.name: IngressBandwidth
parameters.description: The inbound bandwidth limit. Unit: Bps.

parameters.description: The list of init containers.

sub_parameters.description:
The image pull policy. Valid values:
- Always: always pull. Pulls the image every time.
- IfNotPresent: pull on demand. Uses the local image first. Pulls the image if no local image is available.
- Never: never pull. Uses the local image only.

sub_parameters.name: Memory
sub_parameters.description: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The container name.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The init container port numbers.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.Capability.Add
sub_parameters.description:
The permissions granted to processes in the container. Currently, only NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW are supported.

> NET_RAW is not supported by default and requires a ticket submission.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.ReadOnlyRootFilesystem
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. Currently, only true is supported.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityContext.RunAsUser
sub_parameters.description: The user ID used to run the container.

sub_parameters.name: TerminationMessagePath
sub_parameters.description: The source of the container exit message. When the container exits, the termination message is retrieved from the specified termination message file.

sub_parameters.name: TerminationMessagePolicy
sub_parameters.description: The mount information. Default value: empty.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMount
sub_parameters.description: The list of volume mount information.

sub_parameters.name: WorkingDir
sub_parameters.description: The working directory.

parameters.name: InsecureRegistry
parameters.description: The address of a self-managed image repository. When creating ECI instances using images from a self-managed image repository that uses self-signed certificates, configure this parameter to skip certificate verification, avoiding image pull failures caused by certificate verification failure.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The specified ECS instance type. Multiple instance types are supported. For more information, see [Create an instance by specifying an ECS instance type](~~114664~~).

parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount
parameters.description: The number of IPv6 addresses. The value is fixed at 1, meaning an ECI instance supports binding one IPv6 address.

parameters.name: Ipv6GatewayBandwidth
parameters.description:
When Ipv6GatewayBandwidthEnable is set to true, specifies the peak public bandwidth for the IPv6 address. Valid values:

- When the IPv6 gateway uses pay-by-fixed-bandwidth billing, the IPv6 public bandwidth range is 1 to 2000 Mbps.
- When the IPv6 gateway uses pay-by-traffic billing, the IPv6 public bandwidth range depends on the gateway specification:
    - Free edition: 1 to 200 Mbps.
    - Enterprise edition: 1 to 500 Mbps.
    - Enhanced enterprise edition: 1 to 1000 Mbps.

Default value: the maximum value within the corresponding bandwidth range of the gateway.

parameters.name: Ipv6GatewayBandwidthEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable IPv6 public network communication for the ECI instance.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The instance-level memory size. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: NtpServer
parameters.description: The NTP servers.

parameters.name: OsType
parameters.description:
The operating system of the ECI instance. Valid values:

- Linux (default)
- Windows

> Windows instances are in beta. To use them, submit a ticket.

parameters.name: PlainHttpRegistry
parameters.description: The address of a self-managed image repository. When creating ECI instances using images from a self-managed image repository that uses the HTTP protocol, configure this parameter so that ECI uses the HTTP protocol to pull images, avoiding image pull failures caused by protocol mismatch.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The private IP address of the ECI instance. Currently, only IPv4 addresses are supported. Make sure that the IP address is not already in use.

parameters.name: RamRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the instance RAM role. ECI and ECS share instance RAM roles. For more information, see [Use an instance RAM role by calling API operations](~~61178~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: RestartPolicy
parameters.description:
The restart policy of the instance. Valid values:

- Always: always restart.
- Never: never restart.
- OnFailure: restart upon failure.

Default value: Always.

parameters.name: ScheduleStrategy
parameters.description:
The scheduling strategy for the ECI instance when multiple zones are configured (by specifying multiple vSwitches via the VSwitchId parameter). Valid values:

- VSwitchOrdered: scheduled in order.
- VSwitchRandom: optimally scheduled by Alibaba Cloud.

For more information, see [Create instances across multiple zones](~~157290~~).

parameters.name: SecurityContext.Sysctl
parameters.description: Modifies safe sysctl parameters through the security context. For more information, see [Configure Security Context](~~462313~~).

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the safe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context. Valid values:

- net.ipv4.ping_group_range
- net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the safe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs. Instances in the same security group can access each other.

If no security group is specified, the system automatically uses the default security group in the region that you selected. Make sure that the inbound rules of the security group contain the protocols and port numbers of the containers that you want to expose. If you do not have a default security group in the region, the system creates a default security group and adds the declared container protocols and port numbers to the inbound rules of the security group.

parameters.name: ShareProcessNamespace
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use a shared namespace. Default value: false.

parameters.name: SpotDuration
parameters.description: The protection period of the preemptible instance. Unit: hours. Default value: 1. Set this to 0 for no protection period.

parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit
parameters.description:
The maximum hourly price of the preemptible instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places.

This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description:
The bidding strategy for the instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a preemptible instance with a maximum price limit.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance that is billed based on the actual market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

parameters.name: StrictSpot
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to execute periodically:

- true: execute periodically.
- false: do not execute periodically.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be bound. For more information, see [Use tags to manage instances](~~146608~~).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. This value cannot be an empty string and cannot be duplicate. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. This value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TerminationGracePeriodSeconds
parameters.description: The buffer period for the program to handle operations before shutdown. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance is connected. You can specify up to 10 vSwitch IDs at a time, separated by commas (,), for example, `vsw-***,vsw-***`.

If no vSwitch is specified, the system automatically uses the default vSwitch in the default VPC of the region that you selected. If you do not have a default VPC and a default vSwitch in the region, the system creates a default VPC and a default vSwitch.

> The number of IP addresses in the vSwitch CIDR block determines the maximum number of ECI instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan the CIDR block in advance.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: The volume information.

sub_parameters.name: ConfigFileVolume.ConfigFileToPath
sub_parameters.description:
The ConfigFile volume information.

If multiple ConfigFileToPath entries are configured, the total length of all corresponding Content values cannot exceed 60 KB.

sub_parameters.name: ConfigFileVolume.DefaultMode
sub_parameters.description: The default permissions of the ConfigFileVolume.

sub_parameters.name: DiskVolume.DiskId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the DiskVolume.

sub_parameters.name: DiskVolume.DiskSize
sub_parameters.description: The size of the DiskVolume. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: DiskVolume.FsType
sub_parameters.description: The file system type of the DiskVolume.

sub_parameters.name: EmptyDirVolume.Medium
sub_parameters.description: The storage medium for the EmptyDirVolume. Default value: empty, which uses the node file system. The value memory is supported, indicating the use of memory.

sub_parameters.name: EmptyDirVolume.SizeLimit
sub_parameters.description: The size of the EmptyDirVolume. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.Driver
sub_parameters.description:
The driver type when using the FlexVolume plugin to mount volumes. Valid values:

- alicloud/disk: mount a cloud disk.
- alicloud/nas: mount NAS.
- alicloud/oss: mount OSS.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.FsType
sub_parameters.description: The file system type to mount. Default value depends on the FlexVolume script.

sub_parameters.name: FlexVolume.Options
sub_parameters.description:
The FlexVolume option list. This is in key-value format and passed as JSON.

For example, when mounting a cloud disk via FlexVolume, Options represents the cloud disk configuration parameters. The configurable parameters are as follows:

- volumeId: the ID of an existing cloud disk.
- volumeSize: the size of the cloud disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 32768.
- performanceLevel: the performance level of the cloud disk. For more information, see [Cloud disk performance levels](~~25382~~).
- deleteWithInstance: specifies whether to release the disk with the instance. Default value: false.
- encrypted: specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Default value: false. For more information, see [Encryption overview](~~59643~~).
- kmsKeyId: the KMS key ID used for cloud disk encryption.

sub_parameters.name: HostPathVolume.Path
sub_parameters.description: The directory path of the HostPath volume on the host.

sub_parameters.name: HostPathVolume.Type
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the HostPath volume. Valid values:

- Directory: a directory.
- File: a file.

> HostPath volumes are available only to allowlisted users.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.Path
sub_parameters.description: The NFS volume path.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.ReadOnly
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the NFS volume is read-only. Default value: false.

sub_parameters.name: NFSVolume.Server
sub_parameters.description: The NFS server address.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The volume name.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The volume type. Valid values:

- EmptyDirVolume: an EmptyDir volume, which represents an empty directory.
- NFSVolume: an NFS volume, which represents a Network File System.
- ConfigFileVolume: a ConfigFile volume, which represents a configuration file.
- FlexVolume: uses the FlexVolume plugin to extend storage types. Supports mounting cloud disks.
- HostPathVolume: a HostPath volume, which represents a file or directory on the host node. This type is available only to allowlisted users.
- DiskVolume (not recommended): a cloud disk volume. We recommend that you use FlexVolume to mount cloud disks.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone of the instance. If the value is empty, the system automatically selects a zone.

Default value: empty.
